COMMONWEALTH OF MASSACHUSETTS
DEPARTMENT OF ENVIRONMENTAL QUALITY ENGINEERING
Water Quality
According to a recent study by the Corps of Engineers, the area of Boston served by combined storm sewers with outlets into Boston Harbor is 12,300 acres. The area occupied by the buildings to be demolished is 61.4 acres, or approximately 0.5% of the sewered area. Sand and gravel from the demolished sites will be detained in catch basins, which are at every street intersection, which allow settling out of these particles before the storm water enters the storm sewer.
